You need to add these SVG files from your Figma export:

1. linkedin-icon.svg - Large LinkedIn icon for the button
2. linkedin-small.svg - Small LinkedIn icon for navigation
3. github-icon.svg - GitHub icon
4. email-icon.svg - Email icon

Export these from your Figma design and place them in this /public/images/ folder.

The CSS is already set up to use these files.
